schema:
CREATE TABLE articles (Id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, Content TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE categories (Id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, UsageCount INTEGER NULL, FeaturedArticleId INTEGER NULL, FOREIGN KEY (FeaturedArticleId) REFERENCES articles (Id));
correct_query: SELECT Content FROM articles WHERE id = (SELECT FeaturedArticleId FROM categories ORDER BY UsageCount DESC LIMIT 1)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces uncorrelated scalar subquery containing ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 on a nullable foreign key with an INNER JOIN that filters out NULLs prior to LIMIT 1
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT T2.Content FROM categories AS T1 INNER JOIN articles AS T2 ON T1.FeaturedArticleId = T2.Id ORDER BY T1.UsageCount DESC LIMIT 1
